title: Dance Craft
description: Adds dances like Moonwalk, Robot Pop, Thriller Zombie and Floss with a custom cinematic dance menu.
body:
# DanceCraft

**DanceCraft** is a stylish Minecraft dance mod that lets your player perform smooth and iconic dances through a custom cinematic dance menu.

Made for players who want more personality, fun, style, and energy in their Minecraft world, DanceCraft is perfect for videos, screenshots, roleplay, multiplayer moments, and content creation.

## Current Dances

* **Moonwalk** – a smooth and stylish moonwalk-inspired dance with cinematic movement and a dramatic lean.
* **Robot Pop** – a mechanical robot-style dance with sharp poses, controlled body movement, and clean robotic rhythm.
* **Thriller Zombie** – a spooky zombie-inspired dance with creepy steps, horror poses, and undead energy.
* **Floss** – a fun viral-style dance with fast side-to-side movement and energetic player animation.

## Features

* **Custom Dance Menu** – open a clean and stylish DanceCraft menu with a dedicated dance key.
* **High-quality dance icons** – each dance has its own visual preview inside the menu.
* **Loop Mode** – keep dancing for as long as you want.
* **Particles Toggle** – enable or disable dance particles.
* **Cinematic Camera Option** – add extra style to dance moments.
* **Smooth player animations** – designed to look good in gameplay, screenshots, and videos.
* **Great for content creators** – perfect for YouTube Shorts, TikTok clips, thumbnails, roleplay scenes, and cinematic moments.

## More Dances Coming Soon

DanceCraft is planned to grow with more dances and animation features over time.

Future updates may include more viral dances, meme dances, cinematic poses, funny emotes, stylish movement animations, and improvements to the custom dance menu.

## Important

* Made for **Minecraft Forge 1.20.1**
* Requires **PlayerAnimator**
* Client-side style/dance mod focused on player animations and visual fun

You can also find Dance Craft on CurseForge https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dance-craft
